entries.0e947e3463709068: A reportable segment that provides customers in a wide range of industries, including financial institutions, public bodies and general corporations, with a total service ranging from system consulting such as information strategy formulation support, to contracted development of application software, to network design and construction.
entries.5a9577dba7e4c098: A reportable segment that, based on its data centers, provides contract computing services centered on large general-purpose mainframes with a 50-year track record, together with peripheral operations such as data entry, printing and delivery, as well as IDC services, cloud services and BPO services. At its "Internet Data Center (Saitama iDC)," it provides 24-hour, 365-day services from system monitoring to operation, with robust facilities and security. Its cloud services include a private cloud service for corporate systems and the targeted attack email training service "Securism." For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥12,148 million (up 1.4% from the previous year) and segment profit was ¥2,032 million (up 5.6%). The securities report cites growth in orders for operations work for financial institutions and an increase in orders for data center and cloud service projects for general corporations. The related companies are the Company, AGS Business Computer Co., Ltd. and AGS Pro Service Co., Ltd.
entries.5f7becad8916efdc: This is a reportable segment that provides a comprehensive range of services to customers in a wide range of industries, including financial institutions, public bodies and general corporations: from system consulting, including information strategy formulation support, to contracted development of application software and design and construction of networks. After obtaining Level 3 certification under the Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI), the company formulated its own software development standard, 'AGS Integrated Development Standard (INDESTA)', and develops software while receiving quality checks from a dedicated quality control department. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥10,127 million (up 37.7% year on year), and segment profit was ¥1,817 million (up 51.3% year on year). The securities report cites an increase in orders for DX projects for general corporations and an increase in projects for local governments. The related companies are the company and AGS Business Computer Co., Ltd.
